scripts.dev:api: node scripts/uv.mjs run --directory apps/api uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.db:local: node scripts/uv.mjs run --directory apps/api python scripts/local_db.py
scripts.schema: node scripts/uv.mjs run --directory apps/api python -m app.modules.building.export_schema ../../packages/schema/generated && node scripts/uv.mjs run --directory apps/api python -m app.modules.ai.export_schema ../../packages/schema/generated && pnpm --filter @buildai/schema generate
scripts.fixtures: node scripts/uv.mjs run --directory apps/api python -m app.modules.building.fixtures.demo_house ../../data/fixtures/demo-house.model.json
scripts.golden: node scripts/uv.mjs run --directory apps/api python -m app.modules.layout.golden ../../data
scripts.knowledge:lock: node scripts/uv.mjs run --directory apps/api python -m app.modules.catalog.lock ../../data
scripts.benchmark: node scripts/uv.mjs run --directory apps/api python -m evals.design_benchmark
scripts.migrate: node scripts/uv.mjs run --directory apps/api alembic upgrade head
scripts.lint:api: node scripts/uv.mjs run --directory apps/api ruff check . && node scripts/uv.mjs run --directory apps/api ruff format --check . && node scripts/uv.mjs run --directory apps/api lint-imports
scripts.format: pnpm --filter @buildai/web format && node scripts/uv.mjs run --directory apps/api ruff format .
scripts.typecheck:api: node scripts/uv.mjs run --directory apps/api mypy app tests evals
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
